[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is attributed in the registry to DataBank. DataBank Ltd. was established in 2005 in a historic former Federal Reserve Bank building in downtown Dallas, Texas, that had been converted to a data center in 1999, per DataBank own corporate history page fetched this session. DataBank was acquired in July 2016 by a group of investors led by DigitalBridge, per that same page. DataBank own history page also lists a series of acquisitions expanding its footprint, three Salt Lake City area data centers from C7 Data Centers plus facilities in Cleveland and Pittsburgh from 365 Data Centers in January 2017, Lightbound, an Indianapolis based provider, in December 2018, United States and United Kingdom data center assets from zColo in December 2020, and four Houston area data centers from CyrusOne for 670 million dollars in January 2022. A trade press article fetched this session, from pe-insights.com, reports that DigitalBridge agreed to sell a 27 percent fully diluted equity stake in DataBank to Swiss Life Asset Management and EDF Invest for about 1.2 billion dollars, expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2022, reducing DigitalBridge own stake to about 15.5 percent and yielding DigitalBridge about 230 million dollars in cash proceeds. DataBank own history page states the company now operates more than 65 data centers across more than 27 markets. This row, Granite Point Campus SLC5, previously carried a two entry address array in this registry, one entry reading 14870 S Pony Express Rd with a page title fragment attached, and a second entry reading 14850 S Pony Express Rd, an internal contradiction. The operator own dedicated page for SLC5, fetched this session, despite its own URL containing the digits 14870, states the facility own address in its page text as 14850 S Pony Express Rd, Bluffdale, UT 84065, with 10 MW of critical IT load and 49,180 IT square feet. Separately, this session fetched the operator own dedicated page for a sibling row on the same campus, SLC6, whose page text gives 14870 S Pony Express Road, Bluffdale, UT 84065, the same number that had been wrongly carried in this row prior address array. This session concludes the earlier 14870 entry on this row was very likely copied in error from the SLC6 facility, corrects this row address to the single confirmed 14850 entry, and leaves the SLC6 row own separate, already correct address untouched.

reading.body:
DataBank SLC5 in Bluffdale, Utah, publishes 10 MW of IT capacity across 49,180 square feet of technical space, operated by DataBank.

At 10 kW per rack, a common enterprise colocation density, that load supports roughly 1000 racks. At 40 kW per rack, a density closer to AI training workloads, it supports roughly 250 racks. The operator has not published a per-rack power envelope, so neither figure is the operator's own claim, only what the published megawattage implies under each assumption.

No compliance certifications are published for DataBank SLC5. That does not mean none exist, only that this site's dataset, built from the operator's own facility page, does not list any, which limits what regulated workloads a reader could confirm the facility is qualified to host.

Utah has 9 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 8 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 51.69 MW. DataBank SLC5 contributes 10 MW of that total. At that published size it is a small facility relative to what frontier AI training infrastructure requires, which now runs into the tens or hundreds of megawatts, though it may still support inference workloads or smaller-scale AI applications.
